candidates.explanation: Pipeline-aware conservative relaxation with backlog protection: reduce orders only when pipeline is high and backlog is zero, increase only when backlog is high and pipeline is thin. Small coordinated corrections.

rules.when: pipeline > 3 * recent and backlog == 0 and recent > 0
backlog > 2 * recent and pipeline < recent and recent > 0
pipeline > 2 * recent and backlog >= 1 and recent > 0

candidates.explanation: Backlog-sensitive smoothing with growth guard: increase orders when backlog is high and pipeline is low, but avoid over-ordering when pipeline already covers demand. Downstream service protected by limiting cuts.

rules.when: backlog > 2 * recent and pipeline < recent and recent > 0
backlog > 0 and pipeline < 1.5 * recent and recent > 0
pipeline > 2.5 * recent and backlog == 0 and recent > 0

candidates.explanation: Growth-adaptive damping with backlog guard: when recent demand exceeds baseline, slightly increase orders only if pipeline is thin and backlog exists; when pipeline is excessive relative to growth, reduce cautiously. Keeps corrections small and coordinated.

rules.when: growth > 1.2 and pipeline < recent and backlog > 0 and recent > 0
growth < 0.8 and pipeline > 2 * recent and backlog == 0 and recent > 0
pipeline > 3 * recent and backlog == 0 and recent > 0
